_scope_note: Policy-gradient arm of the test-split reference, at the SAME budget (64 per tunable family, 257 objective calls per record) as the sobol_local and bayesian arms. This is the learned search baseline: REINFORCE on a diagonal Gaussian over the schedule parameters. On a synthetic objective it wins the eight-dimensional family at small budgets and loses the low-dimensional ones, so it is expected to be competitive here rather than dominant -- which is the point of running it. ONLINE ADAPTATION: true outcomes are consulted per instance, and nothing is fitted or tuned on these rows.
